levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل

notes: «وقد رواه مالك عن أبي الأسود» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group
«- وهي جدامة -» is the text identifying the woman: she is kept as «جدامة» (the name), with «ابنة وهب» as her patronymic in the text
«قال مالك والغيال» is Malik's explanation of a term, not a chain
